G2 schema-valid export does not by itself entail silent vacuous pass: that outcome is a hypothesized implementation. Required behavior is underspecified.
G3 100-file example does not establish stated different verdict under complete file totality; use admitted partial Coverage and missing per-subject match.
G4 numeric/string operator typing already constrained by FieldFilter.allOf; new role selection is a design choice, not mechanically existing rungs.required.
G5 no-universal-static-negative does not justify withdrawing all imported none/count/all-covered operators; finite observation scope and positive count refusal require separate semantics.
C6 toggling enabled DOES change policyDigest and therefore ruleProgramDigest; the rule array retaining disabled rules does not imply unchanged digest.

C8 ProofInputRef.blob already can name raw bytes; a typed producer-bound subject mapping may be missing but no possible reference is too broad. Actual compiler token extraction remains future qualification, current replay law cannot be deferred there.
C2/C4 withdrawal of export/targetKind is not accepted without considering retained subject metadata and intended functionality.
Pure-law revisions can change schema/registry bytes and transitive identity values; unchanged H algorithms/shapes is a narrower claim. Exact typed-major/migration effects still unresolved.
Not every G1-G9 row has an actually executed or schema-admitted pair of counterexamples; reviewer findings are normative analysis, not measured full replay.
